title: Mystic Fox and Sorceress
description: A surreal nighttime scene inside a decaying ornate room features a realistic fox with glowing purple eyes standing on a dusty floor. In the background, a giant child's face emerges from a starry sky framed by twisted dark branches, while a hooded purple-robed sorceress holds an open red book and a glowing lantern staff beside a dark tree creature with glowing eyes.
prompt: Surreal dark fantasy scene set in a decaying elegant room with peeling walls and candlelight. A realistic fox with glowing purple eyes stands in the foreground near scattered red roses, an old book, papers, a teacup, and a red hourglass. In the background, a giant ghostly child's face merges with a starry cosmic sky, twisted black branches, and a menacing tree creature with glowing white eyes. To the right, a hooded sorceress in flowing purple robes holds an open red book and a glowing lantern staff. Mysterious, ethereal, and slightly unsettling atmosphere.
